desc: Read input N and array A.
Precompute prefix distinct counts `pre[i]` for i from 1 to N.
Precompute suffix distinct counts `suf[i]` for i from 0 to N-1.
Implement the Segment Tree with Range Add and Range Max Query.
Initialize `last_pos` dictionary to keep track of the last seen index of each number.
Iterate `j` from 2 to N-1 (1-indexed), updating the segment tree and querying the maximum.
